The contract uses direct state updates before the external transfer call and emits events for all state changes.

report.overall: TetherToken implements a pausable, ownable, blacklisting ERC20 with optional upgrade deprecation path and limited fee logic using SafeMath. All 15 Slither Medium findings flag ERC20 interface mismatches on transfer/approve/transferFrom signatures across TetherToken, UpgradedStandardToken, StandardToken and BasicToken. No High findings; code uses onlyPayloadSize modifiers and explicit require checks rather than standard ERC20 return values.

checklist.note: Ownable with onlyOwner on transferOwnership, pause, deprecate, issue, redeem, setParams, add/removeBlackList, destroyBlackFunds; owner set in constructor.
deprecated flag routes calls to upgradedAddress via transferByLegacy etc.; no proxy pattern, relies on owner-called deprecate.
No external calls inside state-changing functions except the deprecated forwarding path; transfers use internal balance updates.
No oracles or price feeds present in source.
SafeMath used for mul/div/sub/add with asserts; fee calculation capped by maximumFee.
When deprecated, direct calls to UpgradedStandardToken(upgradedAddress) without return-value checks on transferByLegacy etc.
No signatures or EIP-712 logic in source.
Pausable with whenNotPaused on transfers; onlyOwner pause/unpause; BlackList destroyBlackFunds separate.
approve requires zeroing first to avoid race; MAX_UINT allowance bypass in transferFrom; allowance forwarded when deprecated.
Transfer/Approval emitted; also Issue, Redeem, Deprecate, Params, black-list and destroy events.

slither_triage.why: ERC20Basic/ERC20 declare transfer/approve/transferFrom without return bool; all overrides add onlyPayloadSize or whenNotPaused or deprecation forwarding, producing the 15 reported mismatches on lines 81,91,92,122,167,195,303,311,336,346,365.

report.overall: UniswapV2Factory.sol implements a non-upgradable factory with access-controlled fee setters and CREATE2 pair deployment; all logic for pairs, reserves, and swaps resides in the embedded UniswapV2Pair contract. Slither reports one high (weak PRNG on block.timestamp) and five medium findings (strict equalities and reentrancy paths) that must be evaluated against the actual code. The contract contains no pausing, oracle, or signature mechanisms.

checklist.note: feeToSetter is set in constructor and only the current setter can call setFeeTo or setFeeToSetter; initialize requires msg.sender == factory.
No proxy, delegatecall, or upgrade paths present in UniswapV2Factory or UniswapV2Pair.
swap, burn, and createPair perform external calls (_safeTransfer, uniswapV2Call, initialize) before writing state (reserves, getPair, kLast).
price0CumulativeLast and price1CumulativeLast are updated only inside _update using reserves and timeElapsed; no external oracle calls.
SafeMath used for all add/sub/mul; _update and mint/burn contain explicit overflow guards and MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY subtraction.
_safeTransfer uses raw token.call and createPair calls initialize on newly created pair before storing the address.
No permit or signature verification logic exists inside UniswapV2Factory or the pair functions listed in the findings.
No pause flag, emergency withdrawal, or circuit-breaker code present.
Factory performs no approvals; pair relies on ERC20 transferFrom inside callers, not shown in this file.
PairCreated, Mint, Burn, Swap, Sync, Approval, and Transfer are emitted on all state changes.

slither_triage.why: uint32(block.timestamp % 2**32) is used solely for price accumulation timeElapsed; overflow is intentional and documented in _update.
data.length == 0 check in _safeTransfer and _totalSupply == 0 in mint are standard patterns for optional return values and first-mint liquidity.
External calls in swap, burn, and createPair occur before state updates to reserves/getPair/kLast; lock modifier mitigates but cross-function reentrancy on getPair remains possible.

report.overall: SwapRouter.sol implements stateless exactInput/exactOutput swaps via pool callbacks and inherits Multicall, PeripheryPaymentsWithFee, SelfPermit, and PeripheryValidation. The provided code contains no access-control modifiers, no events, no pausing logic, and delegates to external pools/tokens while using amountInCached transient storage. Slither reports center on the inherited pay() arbitrary transferFrom and Multicall delegatecall-in-loop patterns that are present in the listed base contracts.

checklist.note: No Ownable, roles, or msg.sender checks appear in SwapRouter.sol or listed base contracts; all entrypoints are public.
Contract has no proxy, implementation slots, or upgrade functions in the provided source.
uniswapV3SwapCallback and Multicall delegatecall allow reentrant calls; exactInput loops update payer and path before next swap.
No oracle or price feed calls; sqrtPriceLimitX96 is passed directly to pool.swap.
Uses SafeCast.toInt256 and explicit checks such as require(amountOut >= params.amountOutMinimum).
getPool().swap, pay(), and TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom are called on arbitrary token/pool addresses supplied via path and params.
SelfPermit implements EIP-2612 and permitAllowed with deadline/nonce checks before allowance use.
No pause flag, onlyOwner, or emergency withdrawal functions exist in the source.
pay() performs safeTransferFrom from arbitrary payer; selfPermitIfNecessary reads allowance then calls permit.
No emit statements appear in SwapRouter.sol or the Multicall/PeripheryValidation excerpts.

slither_triage.why: pay() intentionally transfers from msg.sender or cached payer supplied by the swap path; this is the documented caller-pays model.
Multicall.multicall explicitly loops over user-supplied data performing delegatecall; documented behavior for batch execution.
FullMath.sol is imported from @uniswap/v3-core but not present in the supplied SwapRouter or base files; bitwise ^ appears only in the library comment.
WETH9.transfer and some token1.transferFrom calls ignore return values inside pay() and TestUniswapV3Callee.
